## History

Shirley pursued her education and career, working as a teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school before leaving to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) after [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) moved into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During a summer vacation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she admitted to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she had refused Gilbert's proposal. Later, after being rescued in a downpour by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who sent her roses, Shirley wondered if she had found her ideal prince. However, upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and discovering that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever, she endured a grief-stricken night and realized her true, deep love for him. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) recovered, the two planned their future, and friends and guests gathered at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) ahead of their ceremony. On her wedding day, Shirley wed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the orchard before departing with him for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), +18 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's bosom friend, though their close companionship faced an early trial when Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forced them apart and forbade [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Despite this temporary separation, they maintained secret notes and rekindled their deep bond upon Anne's return to school and home. Over the years, they have shared major life milestones together, from exchanging confidences about Diana's engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) to preparing for weddings and handling Anne's departures.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), +20 more_

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began as fierce academic rivals during their school days, competing closely for top honors like the Avery Scholarship and the school medal. Their connection deepened over time into a quiet, meaningful relationship, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially resisted romance and rejected his marriage proposal on the grounds that she only saw him as a friend. However, after a life-threatening bout of typhoid fever forced [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to realize her deep love for him, their bond matured into engagement and marriage.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), +21 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in schoolwork  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) acts as a helpful companion and chum to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while living and working together at the stone house at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). They frequently collaborate on household tasks, such as picking strawberries, tidying up after events, and assisting Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with her wedding preparations and personal affairs.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is a close friend and frequent host to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regularly visits her to offer support, help cheer her up during periods of despondency, and assist with major life events like her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and her subsequent wedding. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also confides in Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) about her personal feelings, including her initial refusal of Gilbert's marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +23 more_

- Friend of — close friends and visitors (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is an imaginative pupil under Anne's tutelage during her time teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as his mentor and teacher, while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers her up with gifts like wild orchids and shares his compositions and imaginative dream-people with her. Their strong bond makes Anne's eventual resignation and departure for college a source of distress for him.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), +21 more_
